old_value: {"id":"vouch-omzm.9","title":"git-vouch-migrate: continuity hardening","description":"Settled by Claude on implementer recommendation, for Mark's review (round 3): (1) auth-subkey continuity requires that subkey to have actually signed the person-file version (listing a copyable public key is not proof); (2) a continuity proof is judged against the person-file version it was made for, found in git history (METARULE 1), so later add-key/retire-key/email edits do not silently drop the holder from draft runs; (3) the late cutoff is enforced by verify-continuity and drafts via --cutoff DATE, comparing the date the proof's commit landed on the registry's main branch; (4) drafts include certifications that had expired by C (same reasoning as SHA-1: the draft is a reminder); (5) drafts --as needs no continuity proof from the certifier (migratedFrom suffices; the draft is signed with the certifier's own SSH key); certifications made with a certifier's other GPG keys are not read for the flag day; (6) a holder sharing an email with another key under a different name may still prove continuity (drafts only repeat certified UIDs).","acceptance_criteria":"Tests with throwaway GPG keys and real git history for each item; runbook updated for --cutoff.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-22T23:21:58.630925872Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-22T23:21:58.630925872Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"vouch-omzm.9","depends_on_id":"vouch-omzm","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-10-22T23:21:58.640869248Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
